players.product: Optical fiber preform (PCVD and VAD/OVD), single-mode and multimode fiber and cable for telecom and AI data centers (G.654.E, polarization-maintaining, multi-core, hollow-core fiber, high-fiber-count ribbon cable); optical interconnect components (optical modules, AOCs, MPO / MMC connectors, FAUs)

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 operating revenue RMB 9,808,962,180, up 53.64% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,924,540,887, up 888.88%. Company: mainly because accelerated AI computing-center construction put the industry into an up-cycle, the revenue mix improved, and both sales volume and average selling prices of the main products rose substantially year on year.

2026 half-year report: optical transmission products segment (preform, fiber, cable and related) revenue about RMB 61.26 hundred million, up about 59.2% year on year, gross margin 63.11%; optical interconnect components segment (optical devices, optical modules, AOCs, pre-terminated jumpers, data-center high-speed copper cable) revenue about RMB 22.38 hundred million, up about 55.0%, gross margin 48.97%.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 61.26 hundred million (+59.2%, 63.11% GM); RMB 22.38 hundred million (+55.0%, 48.97% GM)

quarterly_data.signal: Company (2026 half-year report): new fiber and cable products for AI computing centers carry high process and technology barriers and core strategic customers apply strict supplier qualification; given long-term strong compute demand, short supply of high-quality capacity at scale, fast AI product iteration and custom development, these customers usually keep long-term relationships with leading suppliers. YOFC says it will reinforce its technology and capacity-scale lead to secure leading share and profit levels in AI fiber and cable.

Company (2026 half-year report): it expects 2026 global fiber demand to exceed 670 million core-km, up more than 10% year on year, with data-center-related fiber demand up 69%, now the main source of industry growth.

2026 half-year report: in Scale-up, sales volume of YOFC's high-end multimode fiber rose in the period; its polarization-maintaining fiber for co-packaged optics applications has entered the AI computing-center supply chain with formal certification and volume production (company: domestic share leader for five consecutive years).

2026 half-year report: multi-core fiber (one fiber holds 38 cores, over ten years of R&D) has been applied in metro, AI-compute interconnect and ocean transmission and is in the scale-deployment promotion stage; G.654.E fiber cumulative deployment 8 million core-km; hollow-core fiber cumulative deliveries above 10,000 core-km, record lowest attenuation 0.04dB/km and longest draw 91.2 km, deployed in more than 13 commercial and pilot projects in China and abroad (company: the hollow-core supplier with the widest commercial deployment).

2026 half-year report: subsidiary Changxin Bochuang Technology put 50G PON modules into volume delivery, sampled multi-core / hollow-core fiber components, reached scale sales of high-density high-fiber-count jumpers and patch panels, completed customer-side stage acceptance of 400G/800G AEC solutions, upgraded its 25G/400G/800G multimode optical module solutions, and completed solution selection and design for its 1.6T optical module series.

2026 half-year report: YOFC has 9 production bases in 7 countries (Indonesia, South Africa, Brazil, Poland, Germany, Mexico, Thailand) and more than 2,000 overseas employees; overseas revenue has exceeded 40% of operating revenue in 2025 and H1 2026. Company: it will plan international capacity according to strategic customers' long-term demand to avoid capacity mismatch.

YOFC.why: Vertically integrated preform-fiber-cable maker whose AI data-center fiber (multimode, polarization-maintaining for CPO, multi-core, hollow-core) and interconnect components sell into AI computing centers; revenue rose 53.64% in H1 2026 on AI data-center demand.
YOFC.evidence: YOFC half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): H1 revenue +53.64% driven by AI computing-center construction; polarization-maintaining fiber for co-packaged optics certified and in volume production in the AI computing-center supply chain.
